subject: Beacon Health: upcoming API/model migration — sprint ops & comms questions
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Aug 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Beacon Health: upcoming API/model migration — sprint ops & comms questions

Team —

Heads-up: Beacon Health (pilot customer) received the beta migration notice this morning for the family consolidation we discussed in roadmap sync. They asked for a concise operational plan (dates, rollback, SDK impact) and a customer-facing notice. I attached a quick timeline and a draft notice for review.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you confirm canary schedule and recommended rollback triggers (time windows and metrics) for a 2-week pilot?
- Karthik: will the SDK patch for model-spec changes require breaking client changes or will it be backwards-compatible if they stay pinned to a variant? Need an estimate of dev effort and release date.
- Neha: any data residency/SOC-related redlines we should preempt (Beacon stores PHI-adjacent metadata)?
- Ben: do we have capacity in dedicated pools for a controlled slower ramp if they request extended grace?

Attachments: migration_timeline_v3.xlsx (xlsx) — quick timelines + owner columns; customer_notice_draft.docx (docx) — draft notice with suggested customer language.

Goal: get internal alignment by EOD Thursday so we can send Beacon a clear ask/response and lock the mutual action plan for their procurement/IT teams.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Aug 2024 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Beacon Health: upcoming API/model migration — sprint ops & comms questions

Thanks Irene — quick replies inline.

— Canary schedule: we should propose a 48-hour canary window, with an initial 2% traffic shift, then 10% after 24 hours if error rate < 0.5% and median p95 latency within 10% of baseline. Rollback triggers: error rate spike >1.0% sustained for 15m, or p95 > 120% of baseline for 10m. I recommend we keep the canary traffic during their business hours (PST) to minimize risk.

— For a two-week pilot, ops will reserve a single dedicated lane in the LA pool; I can sketch the exact start/stop commands for the runbook. Need Ben to confirm capacity.

— Customer notice: language looks good; add explicit SDK upgrade notes and a link to the migration guide. Also call out opt-out/grace period window.

Marissa
Sr Manager, Platform Reliability

Subject: Re: Beacon Health: upcoming API/model migration — sprint ops & comms questions

Irene / Marissa —

We have headroom in the LA dedicated lane for a two-week pilot at the proposed canary percentages. If Beacon wants an extended grace period (rolling at 1% per day), we can offer that but it will consume capacity and slightly increase cost to them — I can provide an estimated run-rate once we agree on the traffic plan.

Also: ops runbook needs a shortlist of fallback model variants (stable family builds) in case we need to switch rather than rollback traffic entirely. Marissa — can you include that in the runbook appendix?

Ben
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Beacon Health: upcoming API/model migration — sprint ops & comms questions

Hi Irene & team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the draft timeline. A couple items from Beacon: we need the concrete start date (our board wants a window, not an open-ended pilot), and we need your SDK compatibility note to confirm whether our mobile clients will require a forced app update.

Can we schedule a 30-min call tomorrow (Tue) to walk through the runbook and approve rollback criteria? Procurement is looping in IT for the security Q&A.

Sara Lim
Director of Integrations — Beacon Health

Thanks everyone — quick alignment and next steps: 

1) Start date: propose Sept 9, 2024 for canary kickoff (48-hour window). Marissa — please confirm the canary commands and add the fallback variant list to the runbook appendix by EOD Friday (Aug 23).
2) SDK: Karthik to confirm compatibility matrix and publish a non-breaking patch by Aug 27; if a forced app update is required we will call it out in the customer notice.
3) Security: Neha will prepare a short Q&A for Beacon's IT (SOC/PII handling) and be on tomorrow's call with Procurement.
4) Capacity & cost: Ben to share a run-rate estimate for the two-week pilot and an extended-grace option by EOD Thursday (Aug 22).
5) Comms: I will finalize the customer_notice_draft.docx with explicit opt-out instructions and the start date, then send to Beacon after our call.

Action owners: Marissa (canary + fallback list), Karthik (SDK compatibility), Neha (security Q&A), Ben (capacity + run-rate), Irene (final notice + call coordination).

I'll send the calendar invite for tomorrow's 30-min walkthrough (include Procurement + Beacon IT). Please update the timeline spreadsheet with any schedule conflicts.

Irene
Director, Product Ops — Redwood Inference
